source.name: sportsdataverse-data ESPN college-football player box
source.identity: ESPN athlete_id — the same backbone football/players/ already joins on, so nothing here is name-matched

tackles.basis: an FBS team makes 60-70 tackles a game. Below 40 the column is being filled in for some games and not others.
tackles.reason: the tackles column is producing only 33.76 per team-game in 2023, below the 40 floor. The feed has not filled this column in for this season, so every measure that depends on it is DECLARED MISSING rather than read as a league that never did it.

solo_tackles.basis: roughly half of all tackles are solo
solo_tackles.reason: the solo tackles column is producing only 18.57 per team-game in 2023, below the 20 floor. The feed has not filled this column in for this season, so every measure that depends on it is DECLARED MISSING rather than read as a league that never did it.

tackles_for_loss.basis: an FBS team records 5-6 tackles for loss a game
tackles_for_loss.reason: the tackles for loss column is producing only 2.89 per team-game in 2023, below the 3 floor. The feed has not filled this column in for this season, so every measure that depends on it is DECLARED MISSING rather than read as a league that never did it.

sacks.basis: an FBS team records about 2 sacks a game
sacks.reason: the sacks column is producing only 1.1 per team-game in 2023, below the 1.2 floor. The feed has not filled this column in for this season, so every measure that depends on it is DECLARED MISSING rather than read as a league that never did it.

passes_defended.basis: an FBS team records about 3 passes defended a game
passes_defended.reason: the passes defended column is producing only 1.69 per team-game in 2023, below the 1.8 floor. The feed has not filled this column in for this season, so every measure that depends on it is DECLARED MISSING rather than read as a league that never did it.

hurries.basis: hurries run 2-3 per team-game where the column is filled. This is a PRESSURE SHORT OF A SACK — the thing the player layer used to declare unobservable.

interceptions.basis: FBS interception rate is around 0.8 per team-game

punting.basis: an FBS team punts 4-5 times a game

field_goals.basis: an FBS team attempts about 1.5 field goals a game

qbr.basis: one rated quarterback per team-game is the most there can be

note: games is the count of distinct games this player appeared in the box score for. It is DIRECT PARTICIPATION evidence — not a snap count, which no public feed carries, but a far better role signal than touch share alone.
